source_interface.chain_count_scope: distinct tuples bound by constructed named reach actions; uncalled methods are not instances

numerical_meaning.reachability: exact rational products/sums of canonical binary64 source values; closed annulus; no epsilon or clamping
numerical_meaning.shoulder_interval: exact [-pi,pi), rounded once; rounded positive Pi64 canonicalizes to negative Pi64
numerical_meaning.elbow_interval: chosen branch sign; positive/negative half-turn preserved
numerical_meaning.target_coordinates: exact binary64 result of specified real solution; no comparison tolerance
numerical_meaning.tween_coordinates: exact binary64 rounding of rational canonical start/target/time expression
numerical_meaning.correct_rounding_evidence: Independent exact rational/outward dyadic rounding-cell and real forward-residual proof; finite corpus certificates validate predetermined bits, while runtime must apply the bounded method to arbitrary supported inputs.
numerical_meaning.canonical_limit_order: prove selected rounded coordinate pair, then compare canonical closed limits

goal_projection.status: concrete proposed JSON schema and actual-operation mapping; not runtime evidence
always_required: requested program revision and complete source-unit hashes
context_origin and actual service accepted-head/candidate fields or explicit source-recording nulls
action occurrence identity and source unit/hash/UTF-8 span
typed canonical target and exact frame identity
current availability; sampled lifecycle and separate goal outcome only when actual observation exists
admitted_required: both current coordinate values and rates
both claimed joint identities when running/paused
current equivalent world target and its frame identity
goal_projection.failed_admission_outcome: failure only in request/boundary diagnostic; incoming current projection unchanged

observation_contexts.run_sample: actual nonempty run_id and matching immutable program revision
observation_contexts.constructed_initial: explicit before-zero constructed observation, null run_id; not a fabricated unsampled run
observation_contexts.recorded_prefix: identified immutable source recording, null Agent run/acceptance fields

goal_projection.physical_and_action_rates: joint rates describe current physical state; own action rates are zero pending/paused/stopped/completed even when another owner moves the joints
goal_projection.terminal_snapshot_policy: latched terminal time/coordinates/tip/residual never overwritten by later owners; current physical residual may change
goal_projection.candidate_history_policy: requested candidate, actual accepted head, ever-accepted history and immutable old run/receipt identities remain distinct; after the identical source is accepted, current projection candidate_only is false while a retained earlier candidate run keeps candidate_only true (LP05.09, D27)

diagnostics.meaning: wrong type, including String/Int branch; use inherited typed envelope
different target frame or nonzero target-plane z
unsupported joint/site/authority topology or canonical axis geometry
nonfinite/out-of-supported length, target, duration or coordinate domain
either joint already has a coordinate action claim; neither new claim may survive
exact target radius lies outside closed geometric annulus
equal link lengths with exact zero target radius leave shoulder undetermined
selected canonical joint target outside actual closed limits
required finite canonical solution/residual cannot be established
profile or request work/output budget; no complete lower-level substitute

diagnostic_precedence: immutable frame, chain and scalar domains in source argument order
inherited current motion mode and coordinate claim conflicts
bounded proof of selected canonical coordinate pair
certified rounded-pair residual and completion residual
budget_and_cancellation_policy: budget-counting.md defines distinct units, conservative preflight, full response/intermediate guards and actual-work bounded caching; all numerical work consumes remaining inherited work.
work_and_cancellation_precedence: Check/precharge throughout all phases; a first exhausted budget or observed cancellation interrupts without claiming later mathematical classification.
